section_summary.extract_value: This Limitations section (Study X) notes that conducting the study online may have limited the participant pool and contributed to a lack of ethnic diversity, and that the BAS is a trait-level instrument which limits connecting body appreciation to event-level sexual experiences. It also highlights that relationship quality was not measured and that the sample included a broader range of sexual orientations and non-monogamous relationships, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.
